# `fluxsim calibrate`

Read a Playback's declared scorecard and report the credibility and grade it carries; no fitting is performed. With --fit, fit the parameters a bundle's consumers calibration block declares to the rates of its calibration queries (CMA-ES, from the [calibrate] extra), and write the result as a calibration patch, DIR.patch.json, beside the output.

## Synopsis

```text
fluxsim calibrate [options] [<bundle>]
```

## Examples

```bash
# print the declared scorecard; nothing is written
fluxsim calibrate ./bundle

# record it in the run directory
fluxsim calibrate ./bundle --write --run-id de72fa4b22711c52

# fit the declared parameters to the calibration queries and write ./calibrated.patch.json
fluxsim calibrate --fit ./bundle --profile pinned.profile.json --held-out held-out.profile.json --out ./calibrated
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `bundle` (optional) | path to the FLUX bundle directory |

## Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--playback-id` | `PLAYBACK_ID` | default: the bundle's only Playback |
| `--dry-run` |  | print the scorecard without writing calibration-provenance.json (default) |
| `--write` |  | write calibration-provenance.json into the run directory |
| `--run-id` | `RUN_ID` | required without --dry-run |
| `--fit` | `BUNDLE` | fit the declared parameters of this bundle to its calibration queries instead of reading a declared scorecard; needs --profile, --held-out and --out |
| `--profile` | `PATH` | with --fit: the profile the Simulation pins, whose queries section holds the targets the fit reads; refused when its digest is not the pinned one |
| `--out` | `DIR` | with --fit: where the calibration patch (DIR.patch.json) and, only when the held-out error holds, the calibrated bundle (DIR) are written; neither may exist |
| `--max-evaluations` | `N` | with --fit: raise the evaluations a fit may run above the engine's 64, up to 4096, for a bundle whose calibration block declares no evaluations; a bundle's own value is kept and may only lower the ceiling |
| `--held-out` | `FILE` | the held-out profile: a profile document whose queries section holds the targets of the bundle's held-out consumer queries, which the pinned profile may not name; it is graded beside the pinned profile and read by nothing else |
| `--max-query-seconds` | `N` | raise the seconds one consumer query may take above the engine's 30, up to 600, for a bundle that declares no limits.seconds; a bundle's own value is kept and may only lower the ceiling |
| `--max-query-memory` | `SIZE` | raise the memory DuckDB may use for the consumer queries above the engine's 1GiB, up to 16GiB, such as 4GiB, for a bundle that declares no limits.memory; a bundle's own value is kept and may only lower the ceiling |
| `--state-dir` | `STATE_DIR` | run-state directory (default: ./.flux) |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |
